data.title:
#repost Sasta John Taller distortion kon bola🥺
In case you didnt get it, ref. below explanation.. :)

What is the meaning of degenerate orbitals?

The orbital having same energy are the degenerate orbitals. eg the three subshells of p orbital are px, py and pz. When they are not bonding with other atomic orbital then they are degenerate. In case of s2p1 electronic configuration the one electron of p can stay in px or py or pz because energetically they are same. But when it will take part in bonding then one p subshell will be of different from others
.
